headline.purpose: Clear portfolio structure, not terminal output.

motion.name: terminal-enter
motion.purpose: Translate the already-visible workstation up from 10px; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Color, background, and navigation-border changes; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: boot-line
motion.purpose: One boot line per interval; reduced motion skips the sequence.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Square sage project link, always visible before terminal boot.
components.html: Explore projects
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 19px; background:#b9d883; color:#101211; border:1px solid #b9d883; font:500 .78rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-primary svg { width:16px; height:16px; margin-left:13px; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#e7e6d9; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b9d883; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet text link alongside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:10px 0; border:1px solid transparent; color:#e7e6d9; font:500 .78rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:rgba(185,216,131,.07); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b9d883; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Terminal Input
components.description: Real command field; the containing row gains a faint sage focus state.
components.css: .ds-prompt { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:14px 18px; background:#0c100d; border-top:1px solid #303930; color:#b9d883; font:.73rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-prompt span { flex-shrink:0; } .ds-prompt:focus-within { background:rgba(185,216,131,.07); } .ds-prompt input { flex:1; min-width:0; padding:2px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#e7e6d9; caret-color:#b9d883; font:.8rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; } .ds-prompt input::placeholder { color:#929f8d; opacity:1; } .ds-prompt input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b9d883; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Inline Navigation
components.description: Native anchors on desktop and mobile; no drawer.
components.html: projectsaboutcontact
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:28px; background:#101211; } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:#afb8a9; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; font:.75rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#b9d883; border-color:currentColor; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b9d883; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Project Surface
components.description: Flat surface with a fine border; actual cards pair architecture material with readable descriptions.
components.html:
AI API Gateway

Multiple AI providers behind one clean API.

View project
components.css: .ds-project { padding:25px 26px; border:1px solid #303930; background:#171b18; color:#e7e6d9; transition:border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-project:hover,.ds-project:focus-within { border-color:#4a5748; } .ds-project h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font:600 1.4rem/1.3 'Chakra Petch',sans-serif; } .ds-project p { margin:0 0 20px; color:#afb8a9; font:.9rem/1.75 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-project a { display:block; min-height:44px; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px solid #303930; color:#b9d883; font:500 .74rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; text-decoration:none; } .ds-project a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-project a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #b9d883; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Interest Sticker
components.description: Non-interactive old-web personal detail, not a skill control.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display:inline-block; padding:4px 9px; border:1px solid #4a5748; background:#0c100d; color:#b9d883; font:500 .61rem 'JetBrains Mono',monospace; }

narrative.overview: A dark, human-operated workspace rather than a fictional security console. Angular headings and terminal chrome establish the retro technical character; the owner's avatar, casual copy, and small old-web interest stickers supply personality. This is a portfolio with personal details, not an immersive operating-system simulation.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use the accent for links, the main action, and terminal prompts. Decorative material may use amber, but must not imply fabricated live status.

dos: Do keep name, background, and projects understandable without using the terminal.
Do preserve native keyboard navigation, reduced motion, touch usability, and real project URLs.
Do centralize theme values in src/App.js and check the baseline in src/index.css.
donts: Don't replace personal content with invented system alerts, fake metrics, or remote-server claims.
Don't turn the anime references into a fandom landing page or add a mandatory intro.
Don't bring back particle systems or a custom cursor as a default embellishment.
